Definition: probably from G1492 (through the idea of seeming); similar (in amount and kind):--+ agree, as much, equal, like.
BiblicalUsage: Equal is the word that measures sameness, and the Bible uses it for wages, for Christ, and for the city of God. In Matthew 20:12 the labourers complain, thou hast made them equal unto us, in Philippians 2:6 Christ thought it not robbery to be equal with God, in Revelation 21:16 the city lies foursquare, its length and breadth and height equal, and in John 5:18 the Jews seek to kill Jesus because he made himself equal with God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word holds the gospel together: Christ was equal with God and did not cling to it. The labourers who came last are made equal with the first.
RelatedEvents: The Parable of the Workers in the Vineyard; The New Jerusalem
